source.release_commit: The completed source commit is recorded in README_BUNDLE.md in the distribution bundle.

scope.primary_goal: Define intrinsic O-markings and full very strong Q-markings, their moduli and the forgetful morphism Q -> O with its fibers.
scope.O_marking: The adopted minimal definition includes the intrinsic Gabriel-Krull rank-one torsion-free condition, AZ ampleness, anticanonical Hilbert series and H(A)=A. Exceptionality, smooth properness and a numerical Picard lattice are not included as independent minimal axioms.
scope.Q_marking: Labelled ordered rooted cut quiver; full very strong collection beginning with a structure object; minimal homogeneous augmented presentation of the rolled-up End algebra. No arrow bases, relation bases, presentation isomorphism or potential is marked.
scope.hearts: The base abelian category is reconstructed as anticanonical qgr by its ample pair. The only other surface heart used for comparison is the AS heart.
scope.fibers: Distinguishes the homotopy fiber over a specified base object, the scalar-rigidified homotopy fiber, and the fiber of the map on isomorphism-class sets. Only the last is quotiented by base automorphisms.
scope.second_forgetting: On the actual central-elliptic-divisor AOU locus, every minimal structure object is exceptional. Thus the very-general Lambda/ZK theorem applies to all minimal structure objects there. Exceptionality without a central section in a general minimal O-marked cubic remains open.
scope.relative_moduli: Abelian families A_S and relative perfect dg subcategories D_S are specified separately. A finite thread generates D_S, not arbitrary Db(A_S) over a singular base. Artin formal etaleness and the full-strong-completion etale space are proved under the stated compatible-model assumptions. The finite Weyl quotient is algebraic; its comparison with intrinsic moduli is currently at complex-point groupoid level.

mathematical_status.minimal_consequences: Retained complete proofs: hdim=2, negative self-twist Hom vanishing, nonnegative self-twist Ext2 vanishing, one generic simple class, natural center=C. General minimal-axiom exceptionality remains open in the absence of the extra central-section input.
mathematical_status.heart_recognition: Retained RR-free helix recognition. Added and independently checked: a C-linear derived equivalence preserving O between two hearts with the stated self-twist vanishing is t-exact, by Serre compatibility and asymptotic Hom detection.
mathematical_status.quiver_to_euler: Retained proof and prior audit: three-layer gldim<=2, reverse minimal relation arrows in undeformed CY completion, 18 original arrows, 9 quadratic relations, dim45, standard Euler matrix. Not every retained proof was independently re-audited this revision.
mathematical_status.numerical_inputs: A single standard Q-marking gives smooth proper dg enhancement, exceptional O, K0=Knum and transport of all-object cubic RR/H. AZ/GK comparison identifies numerical rank with intrinsic rank. The lattice chart depends on the chosen marking.
mathematical_status.O_defect: Retained constant defect formula Ext1(O,H^nO)=2delta in a known weak/RR heart. New central-section argument eliminates delta on the actual central-divisor locus; I_p remains only a warning about the insufficiency of the self-Hom Hilbert condition.
mathematical_status.groupoid_fibers: Retained complete point-groupoid proof: raw 2-fiber is disjoint copies of B(Gm^(ell-1)), rigidified 2-fiber is Mark_Q, pi0 fiber is the O-pointed automorphism orbit set. General raw inertia is a central extension; no global product-gerbe assertion.
mathematical_status.weyl_fibers: Combines retained complete line/helix/Weyl proofs with the new quiver-to-Euler bridge. Standard Q existence plus (R0) gives a W(E6)-torsor. Raw fiber: 51840 copies of B(Gm^8); rigidified fiber: 51840 points; pi0 fiber: Gamma_O\W(E6), with 51840/|Gamma_O| points.
mathematical_status.numerical_faithfulness: Generalized, checked: the retained proof requires either standard Q+(R0), or a standard canonical nine-line collection with all relation coefficients nonzero. Line uniqueness, vertex-inner algebra automorphisms and exact-functor dg Morita lifting give faithful numerical action. No assertion about arbitrary unenhanced triangulated functors.
mathematical_status.absolute_inertia: On that locus Aut_ex(A,O) is its faithful finite Weyl image and acts freely on markings; rigidified Q-point inertia is trivial and raw Q-point inertia is exactly Gm^8.
mathematical_status.very_general: Retained actual-AOU proofs give all admissible line classes Lambda and Aut_ex(A)=<H> very generally. First full intrinsic standard-Q pi0 fiber has51840 points; new central-section result extends the second Lambda/ZK fiber to every minimal structure object in this actual locus.
mathematical_status.retained_content: Complete valid proofs of intrinsic line recognition and uniqueness, root affine reflections/halfspaces, root-free cross-block construction, AS/anticanonical reconstruction, actual AOU central-divisor/corner/filtration recognition, very-general line existence and numerical automorphism image, all-order admissible Artin fibers, Picard first-order obstruction/invariants, universal finite algebra and HH/Serre computations are preserved.
mathematical_status.open_problems: Family-level comparison [U/W] with intrinsic O-moduli, relative noetherian/heart/Serre/base-change conditions, coherent Weyl comparisons and descent, relative CY comparison maps, uniform very-strong openness and all incoming Q-marking exhaustion; exceptionality without a central section; image/existence, special roots and boundaries, other OU types, abstract weak-heart A0 recognition.
mathematical_status.novelty: Additional deductions have complete manuscript proofs and the independent checks specified here. Exhaustive priority/novelty review, external refereeing and proof-assistant formalization are not completed.
mathematical_status.central_section_exceptionality: New complete proof, root-reviewed: a central H-compatible natural section regular on O acts eventually injectively on Ext1(O,H^nO) by AZ Hom surjectivity; applying AZ to each fixed extension makes the same action locally nilpotent. Hence tail Ext1 vanishes. RR then gives delta=0. In qgr R with a positive regular central element, its kernel on any rank-one torsion-free object has rank zero and vanishes. Thus Str3=Line_adm on the actual central-divisor AOU locus.
mathematical_status.all_vertex_corners: New complete proof, independently audited: intersect nine finite-degree corner open neighborhoods of the same classical point with the elliptic locus. Each curve corner is a domain, regular central lifting gives the surface corner domain, and the retained AZ/rank recognition proves all nine canonical objects are admissible lines throughout this nonempty open. No all-points root-free hypothesis.
mathematical_status.relative_corners: New complete proof, independently audited: noetherian-base corner tails equivalence, finite generation on both sides, Tor killed by e, compatibility with ordinary tensor base change, and fixed-base intrinsic flatness preservation. Family corollary explicitly uses universally flat tails and assumes right noetherianity after every relevant noetherian base change. These hypotheses are not yet established for the entire actual AOU family.
mathematical_status.relative_deformations: New complete conditional-model theorem, independently audited: flat exceptional objects lift uniquely by Lowen; perfect Nakayama preserves strongness and each very-strong Hom condition; descending evaluation cones prove relative Perf fullness. Raw small-extension lift groupoid is B((1+I)^(ell-1)); rigidified forgetful groupoids satisfy the Artin lifting equivalence. Relative rolled-up minimal-quiver comparison remains an explicit condition when that stronger condition is required.
mathematical_status.completion_etale_space: New application of primary Toen-Vaquie results, independently audited: for a fixed compatible smooth proper dg family and an exceptional first object, full strong completion is a Gm^(ell-1)-gerbe over an etale algebraic space. No finiteness, quasi-compactness or separatedness assertion. Very-strong Q-completion requires the stated heart, uniform-tail and relative-presentation open conditions.
mathematical_status.weyl_birational_action: New complete proof, independently audited: universal two cones and three-term complex over the normalized relation torus define the cross reflection over its function field without object descent. Finite RHom/product/fullness conditions yield rational maps; dense very-general line uniqueness proves Coxeter identities. A classical point with Aut(X)=1 proves faithfulness.
mathematical_status.finite_weyl_chart: New complete proof, independently audited: finite intersection of rational-action domains gives a nonempty invariant affine open U, chosen inside the nine-corner line locus and the finite Morita-comparison domains. U->[U/W(E6)] is representable finite etale of degree51840, including at fixed points. [U/W] is smooth DM dimension8. The free locus has a scheme quotient.
mathematical_status.weyl_point_comparison: New complete proof, independently audited: [U/W](C) is equivalent to the full essential image of the canonical O-family in intrinsic complex-point moduli. All O-pointed exact equivalences are recognized by numerical frames, line uniqueness and normalized relation invariants; automorphism group is Stab_W(u). This does not assert a family-level intrinsic stack morphism or classify every non-line incoming Q-marking at special points.
